authentication.note: These reference screens simulate outcomes. They do not establish a session or connect to an identity provider. Provider and broader accessibility validation remain outstanding.

registration.note: These reference screens simulate outcomes. They do not create accounts, send messages, or validate invitations. Provider and broader accessibility validation remain outstanding.

account-onboarding.note: Simulated examples only. No account, application, purchase, or message is created. Flow drafts are explicitly saved in this tab for one hour. Broader integration and accessibility validation remains outstanding.

application-submission.note: Simulated examples only. No account, application, purchase, or message is created. Flow drafts are explicitly saved in this tab for one hour. Broader integration and accessibility validation remains outstanding.

comparison.note: Fictional offers and simulated availability. Selection starts no checkout and creates no purchase or subscription.

initial-setup.note: Simulated provisioning in memory only. No remote resource is created. Reload resets the preview; checking an unknown result returns fixed simulated success.

public-status-overview.note: Fictional fixed snapshots, not live monitoring. No real incident, refresh request, or notification service.

public-content.note: Static fictional reading examples. Help Article reuses Public Content; no interactive task or real policy is implemented.

checkout.note: Simulated payments only. No payment information is collected and no charge, order, or subscription is created. State resets on reload. Production provider integration and durable recovery remain outstanding.
